manifest.scope: Reuse the same 50 configurations and all five frozen baselines. Only the witness-gated amortized variant is new. A scalar-tree witness W=N certifies C1=N and skips the identity recurrence. Otherwise complete C1 is required. All parsing/selection/witness/inference costs included; same15s/2GiB budget.
manifest.limits: H60 fresh; H16 Rover diagnostics. 256 initial models, 20000 grounded actions; reject rather than truncate. Same indexed exact engine, all initialization/selection included. Optional work <=3s/run, <=.25s/query, <=64 attempts; atomic calls may overrun. Amortized variants reuse selected atom identities with current values/effects and reselect only on loss of common values, <=4 attempts. Resource-tree control work<=300000/run.
manifest.queries: Separate diagnostic: automatic root selection only, thresholds1..16, up to8s total/.5s per bound query; first C0-pass/C1-reject query gets a fresh resource-aware Kraft control (4s/300000 work), exact all 2- and 3-world projections (8s per level), and independent full oracle (8s). Incomplete checks are UNKNOWN, never reported as passes.
manifest.evaluation_stage: Development after all first-study outcomes were inspected; not independent validation.
